question: The atomic size _______ moving from left to right and _______ moving from up to down in the periodic table.
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The atomic size **decreases** moving from left to right across a period in the periodic table.
 
• The atomic size **increases** moving from top to bottom within a group in the periodic table.
